Fresh delicious seafood & SUPER service! 👍🏼👍🏼
Dec 2025 • Family
Great location right on the main strip, next to numerous hotels. A few steps away from voco Ma Belle and Radisson. Really casual, no frills seafront vibe with aquariums for the seafood for you to choose from. Take your pick, they get weighed, tell them how you want them cooked, and served not long after. The amazing part: someone’s going to help you take out the shells! A staff offered to help shell my buttered garlic shrimps. I said I’ll do it myself with my fork and knife. When she saw me taking time, she brought forward a big empty bowl, some plastic gloves, kitchen sheers, and other tools. Then she skillfully removed all the shells so quickly. For the lobsters, she cracked the claws for us and gave us every bit from every corner - nothing wasted from the entire piece. We got to enjoy the delicious fresh seafood more because she took out the stress from shelling them. The other surprising part: you’re not “forced” to tip. Good thing my sister noticed her leaving and heading to a motorbike (as it was the end of her shift), and we were able to say thank you again with a little something. After that feast, they provided us with a complimentary platter of 3 kinds of fruits. That was a nice ending to a very good meal.

Pick your own seafood
Feb 2024 • Couples
We wanted seafood where the locals dine and also experience picking our own live lobster.  Our seafood night out in February 2024, in Da Nang at Nguc Huong Seafood restaurant was fabulous. After looking at the tanks we couldn't decide how to pick so we asked the staff to help us select a small lobster for the two of us.  Steamed Asian style and the rest cooked in a delicious rice congee.  We also had  skewered king prawns grilled in butter.  And of, course ,we had to have morning glory for veg.  This was the freshest seafood we've had on our trip.  Our waitress was super attentive and she helped us with cutting up the lobster and also with recommendations on how to enjoy the rest of the lobster.  There was way too much food for two people. Its a noisy, typical Asian type eating experience. Exactly how we enjoy eating.  Just a note - although they indicate that they accept credit cards - they say the credit card machine is out of order.   And we had to pay cash.  Thankfully we had just managed to have enough cash.

Just As Good Without Seafood
Apr 2024 • Solo
I walked over to this restaurant, just a short distance from the hotel I was staying in. It is an open-air restaurant, so it did not matter where I sat. 

I was introduced to seafood, their specialty, but I politely declined in favour of other dishes. Dinner was the broccoli with garlic and soy sauce-based mackerel and steamed rice. I was concerned I had ordered too much, but was assured when the dishes were brought to the table that the portion sizes were just right. 

Both dishes were well cooked and tasty and the prices affordable. The service was also attentive and non-intrusive.
